details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook running "node beacon.cjs", and index.js also calls the same beacon on import, so the callback fires both at install time and whenever the module is required. beacon.cjs sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header x-beacon-package, carrying only host metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, and the npm user-agent string. It collects no environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents, and it downloads and executes no further payload. The package describes itself as an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports only that it was installed.
